setting.string: Notify when a new wholesale application is submitted
setting.help: Each user in this list receives an email as soon as someone completes the wholesale signup form. Configure at least one or no admin alerts will be sent.

Auto-applied to a customer's partner when their wholesale application is approved (only when a resale certificate is on file). Also receives a zero-rate mapping for every new Sales tax you create, so resale-exempt customers never get charged a newly added tax.

The zero-rate tax that REPLACES a normal sales tax for wholesale customers. A 0% tax keeps the exempt sale's taxable base on the books for the Florida DR-15 return, instead of dropping the tax line. Leave blank to auto-detect a sales tax named '0% Resale'.
